system.effect:
Prerequisites: Major Gift – Nature’s Spirit
Drain 1 AP – Extended Action
Effect: While you are in a non-artificial area, you may use this Feature to ask a question to your immediate surroundings (an area no more than 100m in every direction from you). The spirit of the area will give an answer of a sentence or two to the best of its abilities, but it only knows what has happened in the location. The spirit is not all-knowing, so it could not, for instance, identify a creature that did not speak its identity or have such a thing visible while in the area, but it could give you a description.
